bkvEmployer.title: Why corporate health insurance makes immediate sense for employers.
bkvEmployer.description: A bKV is not a nice-to-have. It is a visible health benefit: employees experience concrete services while companies keep budget, rollout and communication under control.

points.title: More perceived value per euro
points.description: A health budget feels more tangible than a small gross salary increase because employees can use it directly for vision, dental, prevention or treatment.

points.title: Fewer sick days
points.description: Faster specialist appointments can prevent health issues from remaining unresolved and absences from becoming longer than necessary.

points.title: Stronger recruiting
points.description: bKV is an exclusive employer benefit and helps when candidates choose between similar salary packages.

points.title: Retention through real care
points.description: Taking health seriously sends a clear signal: this company invests not only in work, but in people.

points.title: Lean implementation
points.description: Clear tariffs, employee communication and digital administration keep the value visible without overloading HR.

bkvAbsence.title: What fewer absence days can mean financially.
bkvAbsence.description: Faster specialist appointments are not only a comfort benefit. When issues are clarified earlier, absences may stay shorter or not escalate in the first place.
bkvAbsence.note: Simplified model calculation. It does not replace occupational health or actuarial assessment and does not show a guaranteed reduction in sick days.

healthBudget.title: A €3,000 health budget as a strong add-on for your team
healthBudget.description: Not every company can immediately open a large health-insurance budget. This is where the Healio health budget helps: employees combine health-insurance bonuses and supplementary coverage intelligently while you communicate real value.
points: Relevant for employees using naturopathy, osteopathy, vision aids or preventive care
Strong benefit communication even when employer budgets are limited
A clean add-on to pension and health benefits, not a replacement

compound.title: With compound interest, waiting is the expensive mistake.
compound.description: For companies, corporate pension is not just a contract. It is timing. The earlier employees start, the longer capital can work in the background. The visible dynamic often appears later: returns on returns, year after year.
compound.visualTitle: What a later start can cost
compound.visualDescription: Simplified model calculation excluding costs, taxes, inflation and guarantees. It shows the timing and compounding effect, not the concrete performance of a product.

points.title: Time is the lever
points.description: The first years may look small, but they give capital the long runway.

points.title: The turbo comes late
points.description: The strongest effects appear when returns start generating further returns.

points.title: Communication matters
points.description: Employees understand pension faster when they can see the cost of waiting.
